name: Development setup
expected: White HELLO FROM ACME! on a blue screen with a black border.

name: 01_standard_text
expected: A white A at column 15, row 10 on black.
notes: Keep bitmap and sprite projects separate: their memory allocations overlap.

name: 02_multicolour_text
notes: Keep bitmap and sprite projects separate: their memory allocations overlap.

name: 03_extended_text
expected: Four As with four independently selected background colours.
notes: Keep bitmap and sprite projects separate: their memory allocations overlap.

name: 04_hires_bitmap
expected: A red field, white marks near the top left and the plotted pixel at (159,100).
notes: Keep bitmap and sprite projects separate: their memory allocations overlap.

name: 05_multicolour_bitmap
expected: Four pixel-pair values across the first cell and a yellow row in the next cell.
notes: Keep bitmap and sprite projects separate: their memory allocations overlap.

name: 06_sprites
expected: Two sprites using the same data: one hires and one multicolour.
notes: Keep bitmap and sprite projects separate: their memory allocations overlap.

name: 01_hires_platform
expected: A static hires girder-and-ladder character map.
notes: These draw backgrounds. They do not include player collision logic. The scrolling example deliberately blanks the display while redrawing.

name: 02_mixed_platform
expected: A static map mixing hires and multicolour character cells.
notes: These draw backgrounds. They do not include player collision logic. The scrolling example deliberately blanks the display while redrawing.

name: 03_horizontal_world
expected: An automatically scrolling 40-column viewport into a 128-column world.
notes: These draw backgrounds. They do not include player collision logic. The scrolling example deliberately blanks the display while redrawing.

name: 00_kernal_text
controls: Type text; Return exits to BASIC
expected: Typed PETSCII is echoed through the KERNAL.
notes: Reset between graphical examples. engine.asm is shared source, not an independent program. Fire has no action in the direct and spaceship examples.

name: 01_direct_input
controls: W A S D or joystick port 2
expected: Direct horizontal and vertical movement; opposite directions cancel.
notes: Reset between graphical examples. engine.asm is shared source, not an independent program. Fire has no action in the direct and spaceship examples.

name: 02_fixed_jump
controls: A D or port-2 left/right; Space or fire jumps
expected: A fixed-height jump lands on the floor. Holding fire does not auto-jump.
notes: Reset between graphical examples. engine.asm is shared source, not an independent program. Fire has no action in the direct and spaceship examples.

name: 03_variable_jump
controls: A D or port-2 left/right; Space or fire jumps
expected: Release early for a shorter jump. Descending through the ledge surface produces a landing.
notes: Reset between graphical examples. engine.asm is shared source, not an independent program. Fire has no action in the direct and spaceship examples.

name: 04_spaceship
controls: W A S D or joystick port 2
expected: Thrust changes velocity; release applies drag; travel is clamped at the edges.
notes: Reset between graphical examples. engine.asm is shared source, not an independent program. Fire has no action in the direct and spaceship examples.

name: Woodland parallax
controls: A D or port-2 left/right; Space or fire jumps; reset exits
expected: A layered woodland scene with runner animation, scrolling, two-voice music and a jump cue.
notes: PAL only. music.asm and sprite_midground.asm are included modules. Keep the complete assets folder. The bridge is decorative; this demo has no separate bridge collision physics.

name: Music and effect calls
controls: Joystick port 2 fire requests one cue on a new press
expected: Background music continues while voice 3 plays a short effect.
notes: The visible BASIC screen may remain: this is an audio example. Space is not read directly by this standalone program; use port-2 fire or configure a VICE joystick keyset.
